name: Apathy - Inaba Hyakumantetsu in Narugami Gakuen Reikaiki
original_name: アパシー　稲葉百万鉄in鳴神学園霊怪記
source:
Collaboration between Inaba Hyakumantetsu, formerly called Fuhikii, who is a video maker, and [url=/s11627]Iijima Takiya[/url].
The game was showcased on Niconico and Youtube by Inaba Hyakumantetsu, starting from April 24th 2023, to May 7th.

The game was made unavailable after the 3rd September and there is no plan to resell it.
translation:
本作为视频创作者稻叶百万铁（旧名Fuhikii）与[url=/s11627]饭岛多纪哉[/url]的合作作品。
稻叶百万铁于2023年4月24日至5月7日，在Niconico与YouTube上实况展示了本作。

游戏于9月3日后停售，目前没有再售计划。
